content.comment_body: Hello, I'm using a PT1000 sensor with [product_name] [version_no] and monitoring temperature using [product_name] Web Editor. For instance, when the actual temperature reads 25.4, the Web Editor displays it as 254. How can this discrepancy be fixed? Thank you [user_name]
Have you considered adjusting the decimal places parameter in B018 [Analog Amplifier] within the display settings to 1 or 2? It might help resolve the issue.

The advanced web server for [product_name] doesn't support displaying values with decimal points by default. If you're comfortable with HTML programming, you could customize the interface to show decimal values properly.

analysis.insight_summary: There is an issue with accurate representation of temperature readings in the web-based visualization tool for [product_name]. Decimals are omitted, causing confusion and impacting the reliability of sensor monitoring. Community feedback points out that the current version of the web editor lacks built-in support for decimal display, a necessary feature for precise temperature applications.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects that the web editor will display temperature sensor values with decimal places, accurately reflecting the real measurement (e.g., showing 25.4 instead of 254).
